newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, turnover down.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, turnover down.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse turnover fell on Wednesday to 2.59 billion lei from 3.42 billion lei in the previous session, due to investors' lack of interest in the exchange's only two first-tier listings, traders said.
As usual, first-tier Azomures SA fertiliser maker and Oltchim SA chemical plant dominated trading and took some 98 percent of the overall turnover.
Oltchim gained 20 lei to close stronger at 1,700 lei, while Azomures ended 60 lei weaker at 1,520 lei.
Operators said many investors in the two listings had decided to sell shares as they feared their current prices had reached a resistance point.
"Investors think that prices in both Azomures and Oltchim are too expensive and they might fall," one broker said.
Of the 25 listings on the Bucharest bourse, seven rose, 10 fell and four closed flat. Four had no trades.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- fell by 2.7 and respectively 1.49 percent from the previous session.
